name: draw by repetition
note: The game's rule (Game.terminal says 'repetition'): a position whose identity (board, side to move, castling, a legal en-passant square) occurred twice before it in the game record and the line is drawn, either side may claim it; the record's reading is the kernel's Chess.threefoldClaimable (Ideas.Game.chess_threefold_iff, the record built by steps that keep its counts: Record.step_sound) and the draw is worth minus the balance (repetition_level).
